fields.display_title: This paper proposes a framework to learn meta knowledge which helps to transfer architecture search task among different datasets. This is a new attempt to adopt meta NAS on such a scene. This work encode dataset into embedding space, then sample a vector from the space and decode it into an architecture. A predictor is also used to find the optimal architecture.
